description: A version-2 scene shot: a self-contained 3D world-object shot that scene.add / scene.update materializes into an ordinary component clip. The shot owns its layers, camera, lighting, backdrop and normalized local animation; the composition owns start, duration, ordering, cuts and transitions. Coordinates are REFERENCE PIXELS: origin at frame centre, +X right, +Y down, +Z toward the viewer. referenceSize must have the SAME aspect ratio as the composition format; mismatch fails instead of cropping. At equal aspect ratio the shot scales uniformly by outputWidth/referenceWidth. A segment's easing belongs to the keyframe it ARRIVES at; the first keyframe has no easing. Authoring limits: 32 layers, 4 devices, 16 distinct image slots, 256 keyframes per channel, 2048 keyframes per shot. Version 2 supports nested groups, procedural slab/page/phone/laptop objects, screen- and world-space text, admitted image/component/video surfaces, fixed photographic and generated studio environments, transparent/solid/linear/radial backdrops, constraints, focus, grain and vignette. Raw HTML, custom shader props, imported GLB models, arbitrary external HDR environments, skeletal animation and physics are refused with an exact field path.
